proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ _ _ n i j A B hij
  have e : Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => ω i ∈ A ∧ ω j ∈ B) = Fintype.piFinset (fun k => if k = i then A else if k = j then B else Finset.univ) := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Fintype.mem_piFinset]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ k
      by_cases hi : k = i
      · simpa [hi] using h1
      · by_cases hj : k = j
        · subst hj
          rw [if_neg hi, if_pos rfl]
          exact h2
        · simp [hi, hj]
    · intro h
      have h1 := h i
      have h2 := h j
      simp only [if_true] at h1
      rw [if_neg hij.symm, if_pos rfl] at h2
      exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have h : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  rw [e, Fintype.card_piFinset, Nat.cast_prod, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin]
  push_cast
  have hp : ∏ k : Fin n, (((if k = i then A else if k = j then B else Finset.univ : Finset Ω).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) = ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) * ((B.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) := by
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ _ (Finset.mem_univ i), ← Finset.mul_prod_erase (Finset.univ.erase i) _ (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hij.symm, Finset.mem_univ j⟩)]
    rw [if_pos rfl, if_neg hij.symm, if_pos rfl]
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_one, mul_one]
    intro k hk
    simp only [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_univ, and_true] at hk
    rw [if_neg hk.2, if_neg hk.1, Finset.card_univ, div_self h]
  rw [← hp, Finset.prod_div_distrib]
  simp
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) (A B : Finset Ω), i ≠ j → ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin n → Ω => ω i ∈ A ∧ ω j ∈ B)).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card (Fin n → Ω) = ((A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) * ((B.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω)
